description: Five synthetic Fixes near the origin 30 N, 40 W, with the words of the Fix (task 7.5) and the Emergency texts of task 8.1 (computed outside the code from the template of design section 7.12 and the words above; recomputed on 2026-11-19 by an independent script for the count line of two and three sightings and the case of three that disagree, Req 6.11 and 14.11). Read-only: a test is fixed to match this file, never the reverse. The expected words were computed outside the code from the rules of design section 7.8 (95 % scale 2.4477, metres per degree 111 195.08, lengths rounded up). The Fix's Ellipse is the 1-sigma one; azimuths and positions are in degrees, converted by the test with Core. Sighting times are at the centre of a second, as the sighting code holds them. The long axis of an ellipse has no direction: the words reduce its azimuth to 0 to 180 degrees and name one of four axes (north to south, north-east to south-west, east to west, south-east to north-west), so the same axis always reads the same way.
